summary: Classic Buzz threshold-and-clamp distortion: where the input crosses a threshold it is replaced by a fixed clamp level, blended by Amount. Harsh, square-edged fuzz.
quirks: Hot at its defaults: +clamp is 200% of full scale (+6 dBFS), so clipped parts come out at +6 dBFS (profile: +6.0 dBFS peak, +19.6 dB on noise). Set +clamp and −clamp to 100% or less to stay at or under 0 dBFS.
Levels are in percent of full scale: 100% is 0 dBFS, 25% is −12 dBFS.
−threshold and −clamp act only with the Symmetric attribute off (the default); with it on, the positive ones are mirrored.
Mono: ReBuzz feeds it left + right summed (+6 dB for a centred signal).

parameters.name: +threshold
parameters.description: Input above it is clipped, in % of full scale (default 25%: −12 dBFS).

parameters.name: +clamp
parameters.description: Level a clipped sample is set to, % of full scale (default 200%: +6 dBFS).

parameters.name: -threshold
parameters.description: Input below minus this is clipped, % of full scale.

parameters.name: -clamp
parameters.description: Level a clipped negative sample is set to, % of full scale.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: How much of a clipped sample is the clamp level (100%) rather than the input; 0% turns it off.
